title: ENGENHEIRO DE CONFIABILIDADE DE EQUIPAMENTOS ROTATIVOS / Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer
description:
ENGENHEIRO DE CONFIABILIDADE DE EQUIPAMENTOS ROTATIVOS / Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer

We are seeking a professional for the Rotating Equipment Reliability Engineer position to work at our office located in Rio Corporate Office dedicated to Guyana project (MOG).

Responsibilities and Assignments

  • Technical Authority (MOC/TA & Governance)
    • Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with MODEC standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT).
    • Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned.
    • Ensure full documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders.
  • Performance Monitoring & Improvement (Condition Monitoring)
    • Monitor rotating equipment performance using PDM/CBM techniques: vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis (including ferrography and spectroscopy) for early anomaly detection.
    • Oversee and perform Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions.
    • Develop and implement condition‑based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime.
  • Reliability Engineering (RCM/Strategy/MTBF)
    • Develop and implement reliability and maintenance strategies (RCM), with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost.
    • Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and Dry Gas Seal systems; recommend corrective actions.
    • Identify and manage “bad actors,” drive elimination plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
    • Lead RCA for failures and recurring issues using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify effectiveness of actions.
    • Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements.
  • Troubleshooting & Technical Support
    • Provide day‑to‑day technical support to Operations and Maintenance to resolve machinery issues, unplanned shutdowns, and control/operating parameter optimizations.
    • Offer guidance for commissioning/start‑up, operations, overhauls, and controls/monitoring upgrades for rotating equipment.
  • Asset Lifecycle & Projects (Design Review & Installations)
    • Support capital projects by reviewing specifications for maintainability and reliability and ensuring correct installation/alignment per API/AGMA/ISO.
    • Support preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (TRA) and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and systems.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering. MBA/Postgraduate in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus.
  • Experience in rotating equipment operations, maintenance, or reliability in Oil & Gas (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery.
  • Strong knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services.
  • Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and failure diagnostics.
  • Demonstrated troubleshooting and field condition monitoring experience.
  • Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machinery design, lubrication, mechanical seals (incl. Dry Gas Seals), rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis.
  • Working knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816);
  • Deep understanding of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, Dry Gas Seal systems, and gearboxes.
  • Vibration analysis certification (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desired; oil analysis/thermography certifications are advantageous.

Systems & Software

  • Proficiency with CMMS (SAP preferred) and machinery/condition monitoring software.
  • OSIsoft PI System and System 1 knowledge is differential. Advanced Microsoft Office: Power BI is a plus.
  • Advanced English.
  • Active CREA (as applicable for Brazil).

Engineering at Nubank

We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices, that currently includes a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team.

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka
  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS
  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB
  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

As a Tech Manager in Engineering, you'll be expected to

  • Lead a team of 8 ~10 software engineers (ICs)
  • Foster a culture of teamwork, feedback and continuous improvement
  • Conduct effective 1:1s, team meetings and rituals
  • Manage individual contributors, enabling them to be high performers and support others
  • Deliver distributed systems at scale
  • Align stakeholders around team’s vision, goals, and metrics
  • Look and implement improvements in the way we work and organize

Once here, you will

  • Coach and mentor software engineers, supporting their growth and performance inside the teams they are part of
  • Facilitate continuous improvement of team’s processes
  • Ensure the team follows good development processes, is aligned internally and with stakeholders, and consistently delivers quality software
  • Ensure the team maintains a high level of operational excellence
  • Actively drive and improve recruitment
  • Foster psychological safety and facilitate conflict resolution and performance issues

We are looking for a professional who has

  • Experience leading Engineering teams, ideally with a background as a software engineer or software architect
  • Experience being accountable for people management, having exposure to performance assessment, hiring, supporting career growth, etc
  • Experience leading agile teams, being familiar with the most relevant ceremonies, metrics and processes
  • A good level of technical understanding, being able to take part in architecture discussions with Engineers and to translate complex, technical projects and concepts for non-engineers.
  • Advanced level of English - you'll be part of a global team.

The RRS Group

The RRS Group, and its affiliated entities (collectively, “RRS”) have provided real estate development and related services to investment-grade clients for decades. Our expertise encompasses site acquisition, architectural design, and development management for commercial office and industrial properties.

Through an integrated service model, RRS delivers comprehensive enterprise solutions that address every phase of the building lifecycle. In addition to technical excellence, we offer strategic consulting in marketing, financial planning, and facility management ensuring that every project achieves its highest potential in performance, value and sustainability.

Commitment to Community

For over two decades, RRS has maintained a strong commitment to the communities we serve. This commitment is further advanced through the RRS Making Lives Better Foundation, which provides meaningful support and resources to individuals and families in need. The Foundation reflects our belief that corporate success carries a responsibility to contribute positively to society and to improve the quality of life in the regions where we operate.

Our Core Values

Integrity | doing the right thing when no one is watching and acting with uncompromising honesty. We believe in maintaining lasting relationships based on honesty, consistency and the highest ethical standards. This creates credibility in our personal and professional relationships.

Caring | showing concern, empathy and compassion for others, ourselves and our environment. Our care shows itself in our commitment to “safety first” in all we do. We encourage each other to be the best and hold each other accountable. We help those in need, contribute to the communities in which we work and develop creative ways to be responsible with our resources.

Integration | working unselfishly toward common goals across disciplines, teams, departments and regions. Our collective contributions are greater than our skills. We will be transparent and understand each other’s expertise to provide the most value when delivering our services to one another and our clients.

Innovation | developing new ideas and applying the solutions that differentiate us in valuable ways. We are not comfortable with the status quo. We remain accountable for continuous improvements in our results because we do not consider innovation an end in itself. We maintain an environment where we foster new ideas and encourage changes that help us improve.

Full Stack AI Engineer

We’re seeking a Full Stack AI Engineer who can design, build, and ship AI‑powered products end‑to‑end from data layer to user interface. This role is for a builder who thrives at the intersection of modern app engineering and applied AI, and who wants to create products that directly improve how real estate assets are managed, leased and optimized across a multi‑billion dollar global portfolio.

What You’ll Do

Build AI‑Powered Products End‑to‑End

  • Build and integrate AI/ML capabilities into production applications — including LLM‑powered workflows, MCP tool integrations, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) and predictive analytics.
  • Own features from concept through deployment: frontend UI, API design, backend services, data pipelines and AI model integration.
  • Rapidly prototype and iterate on AI‑driven features, moving from proof of concept to production with speed and quality.

Engineer for Scale and Performance

  • Build responsive, accessible frontend interfaces using modern frameworks (React/Next.js or similar).
  • Design and implement scalable backend services and APIs (Python, Node.js, or similar) that serve both human users and AI agents.
  • Work with cloud infrastructure (Azure preferred) including serverless functions, container orchestration and managed AI/ML services.
  • Ensure production systems are reliable, observable and secure — with appropriate monitoring, logging and error handling.

Collaborate and Ship

  • Partner with Product Management, Design, Business owners and Data Engineering to define and deliver high‑impact features.
  • Participate in architectural decisions that affect the broader platform, advocating for simplicity, maintainability and AI‑readiness.
  • Collaborate with other engineers on AI integration patterns, prompt engineering and modern development practices. We are an AI‑forward team and it’s moving fast so we test, iterate, share and repeat.

Qualifications

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping production applications.
  • Strong proficiency in both frontend (React, TypeScript, modern CSS) and backend (Python, Node.js, or Go) development.
  • Deep experience with AI coding tools like Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, etc.
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, microservices and event‑driven architectures.
  • Solid understanding of relational and non‑relational databases, caching strategies and data modeling.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and cloud platforms (Azure preferred, AWS/GCP acceptable).

AI/ML Integration

  • Hands‑on experience integrating LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic or similar) into production applications — including prompt engineering, function calling and agent workflows.
  • Familiarity with RAG architectures, vector databases, embedding models, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool‑use patterns.
  • Understanding of when to build vs. buy AI capabilities and how to evaluate AI vendor tools critically.
  • Personal projects or portfolio demonstrating AI‑powered applications you’ve built — we want to see what you’ve shipped.

Domain Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Experience in real estate, property management or asset management is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with marketplace or multi‑sided platform products.
  • Experience working in data‑intensive environments where data quality and governance matter.

Mindset & Communication

  • AI‑first mindset — you naturally look for opportunities to automate, augment and accelerate with AI in your daily work and product development.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical trade‑offs to non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping iteratively over waiting for perfection.
  • Collaborative approach; you work well across product, design, data and business teams.

What can you expect from us

  • Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.
  • Internal digital platforms that promote self‑learning.
  • Development programs according to leadership skills.
  • Specialized training according to the role.
  • Learning experiences with internal and external providers.
  • Recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life and more.
  • Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life.
  • A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle.
  • Family‑related benefits such as our WellnessLine, thousands of agreements and discounts, scholarship programs for your children, aid plans for different moments of life and more.

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. title: Senior Manager, Ceremonies
description:
Senior Manager, Ceremonies

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC27”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

THE POSITION

The Ceremonies Senior Manager leads the end‑to‑end planning, creative development, and operational delivery of all official ceremonies for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, including the Opening and Closing Ceremonies, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Pre‑Match Ceremonies (PMC), the Final Match Half‑Time Show (if applicable), and all additional ceremonial moments.

Reporting to the Head of Entertainment, this role is responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of each ceremony—from planning and preparation through to live execution—ensuring full alignment with FIFA’s vision and brand standards. The role also manages the implementation of the operational delivery across the entire FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, in accordance with the Ceremonies Concept developed by FIFA.

Working closely with the Entertainment team and key Functional Areas, the Ceremonies Senior Manager acts as the senior operational lead for all ceremony delivery, ensuring creative and operational approvals are met and delivering iconic, culturally resonant moments that celebrate women’s football on its biggest global stage.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ceremonies Project Leadership

  • Lead the operational delivery and implementation of the Ceremonies Concept provided by FIFA.
  • Manage the end-to-end planning and delivery of all official ceremonies across the FWWC27 tournament.
  • Oversee ceremonies planning and delivery from concept development through preproduction, execution, dissolution, and legacy handover.
  • Ensure full alignment with the Entertainment team in Zurich across all ceremonial workstreams.
  • Manage the approval process for all ceremony related creative and operational deliverables.
  • Provide senior decision-making support on creative direction, technical feasibility, and operational prioritisation.
  • Lead the development of ceremony operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and show formats for all ceremonies, including PMC.
  • Coordinate with Venue Management, Broadcast, Safety & Security, and other Functional Areas to integrate ceremonies seamlessly into matchday and event day operations.
  • Act as the senior escalation authority for all ceremony related operational matters.
  • Ensure all ceremonies reflect the approved creative vision, brand standards, cultural sensitivities, and tournament wide entertainment strategy.

Team Leadership

  • Manage and mentor the Ceremonies Team, providing clear direction, performance oversight, and accountability structures.
  • Mentor and support all Ceremonies personnel, including fulltime staff, freelancers, and event time workforce, ensuring consistent standards, development pathways, and operational readiness.
  • Support internal talent development through coaching, guidance, and structured feedback.
  • Build team structures and optimize collaboration across creative, technical, and operational units.
  • Foster strong coordination between venue based ceremonies teams to maintain consistency in delivery standards and operational execution.
  • Foster strong teamwork, knowledge exchange, and operational alignment with the Stadium Entertainment Team to ensure unified delivery across all entertainment and ceremonial workstreams.

Major Ceremonies Oversight

  • Manage planning and delivery management for all major ceremonial events, including: Opening Ceremony, Closing Ceremony, Medal and Trophy Ceremonies, Final Match Half-Time Show (if applicable), Pre-Match Ceremonies throughout the tournament
  • Ensure that each major ceremony reflects the ambition, brand standards, and cultural significance of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Creative & Concept Development / Creative Concept, Content Production & Management

  • Collaborate with the Entertainment team to develop and refine the ceremonial concept and creative direction for each ceremony.
  • Integrate host country cultural elements into ceremonial programming in a meaningful, authentic, and respectful way.
  • Oversee creative brief development, content commissioning, and pre-production workflows with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Ensure all creative content — including music, graphics, videos, scripts, translations, choreography and performances — is approved and locked in line with operational timelines.
  • Manage stakeholder approval pathways to ensure content is delivered and archived in accordance with operational requirements.
  • Manage IP and copyright compliance for all ceremony content.

Planning Scheduling & Documentation

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, WIP reports, and milestone trackers for all ceremony workstreams.
  • Ensure all operational and creative decisions are fully documented and version controlled.
  • Manage multiple suppliers, conduct regular update meetings, coordinate implementation processes, and supervise payments and reporting.
  • Prepare written and oral presentations, high-level briefings, and reports for senior leadership and FIFA counterparts.
  • Organize and participate in Review, Project Team, and Status Update meetings.
  • Lead the creation, management, and archiving of project plans, workflows, venue documentation, and readiness tools across all ceremony workstreams.
  • Manage the development of operational plans, production schedules, rundowns, and rehearsal programmes for all ceremonies.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision-maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination for all ceremonies.
  • Direct venue-level pre-production processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, and infrastructure planning.

Supplier & Budget Management

  • Lead early stage budget modelling, scenario planning, and resourcing strategies to support creative and operational planning.
  • Develop and manage Scopes of Work, Procurement activities, supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, in line with FWWC27 management and procurement policies. Manage procurement activities for stadium entertainment suppliers, including RFP development, evaluation, and contract negotiation.
  • Maintain full budget oversight including forecasting, cost control, variations, and invoicing. Manage budget oversight for the stadium entertainment workstream, including forecasting, cost control and invoicing.
  • Ensure contractual deliverables and timelines are aligned with preproduction schedules and operational readiness requirements.
  • Conduct regular supplier update meetings and coordinate implementation processes.
  • Supervise payments, deliverables and performance reports from entertainment suppliers.

Stakeholder & Functional Area Liaison

  • Act as the senior liaison between the Ceremonies Team and all relevant Functional Areas, including Venue Operations, Broadcast, Safety & Security, Marketing, and FIFA SPE.
  • Deliver concise briefings, alignment updates, and escalation management across all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain relationships with Host Country national bodies, cultural organizations, and local partners contributing to ceremonies.
  • Ensure early phase cross functional integration to support seamless operational delivery.

Venue Readiness & Execution

  • Lead preparation of Site Operational Plans (SOPs), ceremony production schedules, and PMC rundowns.
  • Direct venue level preproduction processes including technical surveys, staging assessments, performer logistics, and infrastructure planning.
  • Ensure readiness standards are met at all ceremony venues and oversee execution on the day of each event.
  • Act as the key operational decision maker to maintain seamless delivery during live ceremonies.
  • Oversee rehearsal planning, scheduling, approvals and stakeholder coordination.
  • Ensure all creative and technical elements are validated during pre event testing and rehearsal phases.

Other Duties

  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by senior managership aligned with project delivery.
  • Represent the Ceremonies function in cross-functional planning forums and senior managership briefings.
  • Support the Head of Entertainment in strategic planning, operational readiness, and tournament wide entertainment integration.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or similar level of higher education or equivalent in industry experience.

Experience

  • 7+ years' experience in live event production and ceremonies management, ideally within major international sporting events or large-scale public events.
  • Prior experience in a FIFA tournament or comparable major international sports event is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, large-scale ceremonies including opening/closing ceremonies and awards presentations.
  • Proven track record in team managership, creative development, supplier management, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Significant experience managing RFP/procurement processes and overseeing multi-supplier contracts and budgets.
  • Experience integrating cultural programming and working with national cultural bodies and creative agencies.

Skills & Competencies

  • ADMINISTRATIVE SKILLS: Ability to manage office and production documentation including, RFPs, presentations, show rundowns, rehearsal schedules, scripts, and permits accurately.
  • ADAPTABILITY: Ability to adapt to evolving creative direction and operational challenges in high-pressure environments.
  • FLEXIBILITY: Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, across the full tournament period.
  • COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to manage complex stakeholder relationships at a senior level.
  • ORGANIZATIONAL SKILLS: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent ceremony workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • PROBLEM‑SOLVING SKILLS: Strategic and creative approach to problem‑solving; ability to make clear decisions under pressure.

description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in software development who can design and evolve modern architectures, lead engineers through best practices, and collaborate directly with client stakeholders on solution design and technical decisions. You will set engineering standards for the team, perform code reviews, coach developers, and ensure we deliver secure, reliable, and scalable software.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Define and evolve application architectures (monoliths, microservices, event‑driven), ensuring clear domain boundaries, integration patterns, and API contracts.
  • Lead architectural reviews and technical decision‑making, balancing trade‑offs across scalability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Ensure non‑functional requirements (reliability, observability, security, and performance) are embedded throughout design and delivery.
  • Drive the development of high‑quality .NET services and APIs, setting technical direction for standards, versioning, and documentation.
  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices through code reviews, CI/CD alignment, clean and secure coding standards.
  • Act as a technical leader, mentoring the team, fostering continuous learning, and enabling scalable, observable solutions.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field.
  • Strong experience in software development and AI experience.
  • Solid architectural knowledge (DDD, CQRS, monolith vs. microservices, event‑driven systems).
  • Proven technical leadership, including code reviews, branching strategies, and guidance on best practices.
  • Deep knowledge of the .NET ecosystem (C#, ASP.NET Core, API design, async programming, relational databases).
  • Experience with cloud environments, containers, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Solid understanding of observability and security fundamentals.
  • Experience collaborating with front‑end teams and applying modern testing practices.
  • Ability to discuss solutions with client architects, negotiate trade‑offs, and justify decisions.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

The specific and existing team takes care of the sales of industrial steam turbines in Latin America in different industries up to a size of 250 MWe.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met optimally and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150‑year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards

  • Supportive work culture and a healthy work‑life balance
  • Flexible work environment with flex hours, telecommuting and digital workspaces
  • Competitive total rewards package
  • Flexible benefits and savings programs
  • Rewarding vacation entitlement with the opportunity to buy and sell vacation
  • Parental leave
  • Profit sharing
  • Contribute to our social responsibility initiatives
  • Diversity and inclusivity focus

title: Pricing & Payments Manager, Partner Strategy & Experience
description:
Description

Amazon is the most customer-centric company on Earth. We need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people who are passionate about doing the right thing.

We are looking for a Pricing & Payments Manager to lead the Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes function within Amazon's Last Mile Brazil organization. This role owns the end-to-end strategy and execution of partner pricing models, incentive programs, payment accuracy, and dispute resolution across our Amazon Partner Logistics programs — EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics), and AMXL (Amazon Extra Large).

As a People Manager, you will lead and develop a team of specialists, set the strategic direction for pricing and payment mechanisms, build scalable processes, and drive cross-functional alignment with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to ensure partner economics are competitive, accurate, and sustainable.

This position is based out of an Amazon corporate office and may require periodic travel.

If you are passionate about partner economics, operational excellence, and building high-performing teams, you should join our team.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Pricing, Incentives, Payments & Disputes specialists, fostering a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement
  • Own the end-to-end pricing strategy for logistics partners across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL programs, ensuring competitive and sustainable rate structures
  • Design, implement, and optimize incentive programs that drive partner performance, network efficiency, and cost effectiveness
  • Oversee the payment lifecycle — from invoice validation and payment accuracy to dispute identification, root cause analysis, and resolution
  • Build and maintain scalable mechanisms for pricing governance, incentive tracking, payment reconciliation, and dispute management
  • Develop structured reporting and dashboards to monitor pricing competitiveness, incentive ROI, payment accuracy, and dispute aging/resolution rates
  • Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Operations, Procurement, and Legal to align pricing models with business objectives and contractual frameworks
  • Identify and drive automation opportunities to reduce manual intervention in payment and dispute processes
  • Conduct periodic pricing benchmarking and market analysis to ensure Amazon's partner economics remain competitive
  • Manage escalations related to partner payments and disputes, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder alignment
  • Define and track KPIs for the team, establishing clear goals, performance standards, and development plans for direct reports

A day in the life

Your day starts with metrics review and team's priorities. Your focus centers on strategic decisions that shape partner economics across EDSP, AMPL, and AMXL. You lead cross-functional negotiations with Finance, Operations, and Procurement to align pricing models with business objectives. You assess incentive program ROI, recommending adjustments to optimize cost efficiency and partner performance. You review payment accuracy dashboards, identifying systemic gaps and designing scalable mechanisms to address them. Between meetings, you coach your team on stakeholder influence and data-driven storytelling. Every day balances strategic thinking, cross-functional alignment, and talent development to drive sustainable partner economics at scale.

About The Team

The Pricing & Payments team is part of Amazon Logistics' Partner Strategy & Experience organization, supporting the EDSP (External Delivery Service Provider), AMXL (Amazon Extra Large), and AMPL (Amazon Partner Logistics) programs across Brazil — a network of +30 logistics partners and +300 operational nodes. Our mission is to ensure Amazon's logistics partners operate under competitive, transparent, and accurate pricing and payment frameworks, while driving performance through well-designed incentive programs and efficient dispute resolution. We build scalable pricing models, payment governance mechanisms, and incentive strategies that balance cost efficiency with partner sustainability. The team sits within a broader strategic structure that also covers Compliance & Communications, Network Health & Performance, and VAS & DA Experience — working cross-functionally to support Amazon's Last Mile growth in Brazil.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business, operations, logistics, supply chain or engineering
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Experience managing and developing high performance teams
  • Experience conducting sophisticated and creative analysis of complex data and translate the results into actionable deliverables, messages, and presentations
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across business development, marketing, operations, product development, legal, etc.
  • Experience implementing scalable compliance solutions (technology, procedures, processes, etc.) in a regulated environment
  • Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English
  • Experience in deal management and pricing strategy, or financial consulting

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA, or Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
  • Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
  • Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques
  • Experience in logistics
  • Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing efforts, transportation and logistics, or fulfillment and distribution centers
  • Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis, or experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field

title: Knowledge Management Technical Author
description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical communication, knowledge structuring and collaboration are essential to enabling engineering excellence?

Would you enjoy transforming complex technical information into accessible, clear and high‑quality documentation that supports teams across a global organization?

Join our Knowledge Management Team!

At Baker Hughes, Knowledge Management (KM) is essential for accelerating learning, promoting collaboration, and ensuring that expertise is captured and shared across the organization. Our KM team drives digital collaboration tools, documentation excellence, and user‑centric solutions that support engineering, technology and business functions.

Partner with the best!

As a Knowledge Management Technical Author, you will collaborate with engineers, subject matter experts and business stakeholders to develop high‑quality technical documentation and maintain digital KM platforms—primarily based on SharePoint. You will help shape a business‑wide system that enables collaboration, governance and efficiency across Flexible Pipe Systems (FPS) and other OFSE teams.

As a Knowledge Management Technical Author, you will be responsible for:

Technical Writing & Content Development

  • Researching and gathering knowledge from engineers and technical specialists to understand complex products, processes and systems.
  • Producing clear, concise and technically accurate documentation including manuals, guides, communication materials, instructions and support resources.
  • Applying translation responsibilities (English Portuguese) across the department.
  • Reviewing, editing and simplifying existing documents to ensure accuracy, consistency and clarity.
  • Creating diagrams, illustrations, screenshots and other visuals to support engineering explanations.

Knowledge Management & Content Governance

  • Updating and maintaining libraries of technical information within CMS platforms and KM repositories.
  • Ensuring documentation aligned with Baker Hughes standards remains up‑to‑date, correct and consistent.
  • Supporting implementation of KM methodologies, continuous improvement and Lean practices.
  • Identifying and eliminating roadblocks to knowledge sharing while promoting best practices.

SharePoint & Digital Collaboration

  • Creating, managing and updating SharePoint content, pages, templates and tools used across FPS.
  • Supporting system efficiency through communication, training and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinating upgrades, improvements and fixes within the KM environment.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Consulting

  • Meeting with teams to develop documentation, templates and SharePoint content aligned with business needs.
  • Reviewing new materials with users and experts to ensure relevance and quality.
  • Partnering closely with FPS Chief Engineers’ Office and global KM teams.
  • Advising on document formatting, intellectual property, branding, confidentiality classifications and export control requirements.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role, you will:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
  • Have fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Have proven experience as a Technical Writer, Technical Author or similar documentation‑focused role.
  • Familiarity with Knowledge Management principles and methodologies.
  • Have proficiency in MS Office and adaptability to digital tools used for documentation and collaboration.
  • Have experience with SharePoint (coding knowledge is beneficial but not required).
  • Have previous experience in the Oil & Gas industry or an equivalent technical sector.
  • Have excellent written communication skills with strong attention to detail and clarity.
  • Have the ability to learn complex technical topics and participate in technical discussions.
  • Have the ability to work independently and collaboratively with global, cross‑functional teams.
  • Have strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Have familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE).
  • Have an understanding of the Engineering Lifecycle.
  • Willingness to travel internationally if required (desirable).
  • Experience developing Power Apps, Power BI dashboards or Power Automate flows (desirable).

Work in a way that works for you

In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working from 7am-4pm or 8am-5pm.

Working for you

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
Job Overview

In this role, you will be responsible for creating clear, structured, and highly technical documentation for internal engineering systems, partnering closely with senior developers and infrastructure teams. You’ll apply a strong foundation in software engineering along with hands‑on knowledge of cloud and DevOps environments— including Azure GovCloud, infrastructure provisioning with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, PostgreSQL operations and disaster recovery, configuration management, and observability best practices. You’ll produce concise how‑to guides, installation and troubleshooting procedures (PowerShell/Bash), and standardized content organized for developer audiences using defined templates. Success in this role requires proficiency with Confluence, GitHub, Jira, and diagramming tools, plus excellent information architecture skills. You’ll also independently manage limited SME availability through effective interviewing and scheduling, while communicating directly with Directors and Lead Engineers to deliver accurate, user‑friendly documentation.

Required Skills and Expertise

Software Engineering Foundation

  • A deep understanding of software development and engineering principles is a primary requirement.
  • Cloud & DevOps Literacy: The writer must be comfortable documenting highly technical, internal‑facing systems.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Azure (GovCloud/IL4), cloud architecture, Infrastructure as a Service, Terraform, and provisioning.
  • CI/CD: Complex continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • Databases: PostgreSQL provisioning, operations, and disaster recovery (DR).

Configuration Management

  • Documenting unified configuration systems and migration from legacy tools.
  • Observability: Writing best practices for monitoring and alerting.

Core Documentation & Writing Skills

  • Clarity and Conciseness: The ability to create clear, concise, and user‑friendly documentation.
  • Procedural Writing: The writer must be able to create clear how‑to guides, particularly for installation (using PowerShell/Bash) and troubleshooting.
  • Information Architecture: The project requires standardizing formats and organizing content logically for a developer audience (e.g., "Onboarding," "Infrastructure," "Troubleshooting") to improve findability.
  • Template Adherence: The writer must be able to follow specific templates, such as the MSF Docs Single Page Design, which outlines a precise structure for content.

Tool Proficiency

  • Content Platforms: Confluence and GitHub as the primary documentation platforms.
  • Collaboration Tools: Familiarity with Jira for project tracking and Lucidchart (or similar) for diagrams if necessary.

Soft Skills

  • SME Management: Managing the limited availability of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) is a primary risk.
  • Strong interviewing skills and the ability to work independently to proactively schedule and manage SME time.

Stakeholder Communication

The role requires collaborating directly with senior engineering stakeholders, including Directors and Lead Software Engineers.

Benefits

  • Flexible working format—remote, office‑based or flexible
  • Competitive salary and compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location‑specific benefits
  • Not applicable for freelancers

For those familiar with Brazil's local business environment and with catering/retail merchant resources, the experience requirements may be appropriately relaxed.

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. description:
As a Technical Supervisor Electrical & Instrumentation , you play a crucial coordinating role in ensuring the safety, reliability and quality of our electrical LV/HV installations and electrical work equipment across all our sites and vessels.

Rather than a purely hands‑on technician position, this is a supervisory and organisational role , focused on electrical safety, compliance, inspections, documentation, and the correct execution of work by internal staff and subcontractors.

You will work across our offices and yards: Heijningen (workshop), Rotterdam (warehouse), Eindhoven (Research & Development) and Enschede (fabrication). Occasionally, you will travel offshore to support our vessels.

Your most important responsibilities

Electrical safety & compliance

  • Ensure the safe operation of all LV/HV electrical installations and electrical work equipment.
  • Develop, implement and safeguard policies regarding electrical safety in accordance with applicable standards and legislation.
  • Establish and maintain access regulations for areas with electrical hazards.
  • Organise and coordinate periodic inspections of installations and equipment.
  • Ensure timely remediation of any identified defects.
  • Conduct electrical safety risk analyses and internal audits to continuously improve safety and reliability.

Procedures & documentation

  • Prepare work procedures for operation, maintenance and inspection; include procedures for isolation and making installations inactive.
  • Keep technical documentation up to date and maintain records of incidents and relevant work activities.
  • Collect and provide information for as‑built drawings and diagrams.

Coordination & supervision

  • Supervise electrical activities carried out by subcontractors and third parties.
  • Ensure safe, efficient and compliant execution of works on board and on site.
  • Coordinate with internal technical staff and advise crew where required.
  • Appoint competent and qualified personnel and ensure training and instruction needs are met.
  • Prepare annual and multi‑year (5‑10 year) maintenance, improvement, and modification budgets in collaboration with budget holders and internal stakeholders.
  • Draft technical specifications for new or upgraded installations.

Support & cooperation

  • Support equipment electricians with troubleshooting and maintenance activities when required.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of systems, procedures and technologies used within the organisation.

What we expect from you

  • Good command of English and Dutch; many technical documents are in Dutch.
  • Minimum MBO degree in electrical engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in a similar role within an industrial environment.
  • Experience within offshore, dredging, construction or shipbuilding industry is a great asset.
  • Knowledge of relevant legislation and standards (e.g. Arbowet, NEN 1010).
  • NEN 3140/3840 IV or WV certification or willingness to obtain; STIPEL certification is a strong asset.
  • Accurate, flexible and cost‑aware professional with a creative attitude.
  • Willingness to occasionally travel and work abroad or offshore.

What we offer

  • Competitive industry‑benchmark salary and excellent pension.
  • Performance‑based salary raises and bonuses.
  • 30 holiday days per year, flexible working hours.

title: Sr. Finance Systems Analyst
description:
Position Summary

The Senior Finance Analyst – Clinical Solutions Portfolio is a strategic, business‑partnering role responsible for portfolio‑level financial analysis across Clinical Solutions departments. The primary focus is project and portfolio financial health, including forecasting, budget performance, and financial controls, with an expanding remit into trial operations KPIs and measures as they relate to budget integrity, scope control, and delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong background in Project Finance within a CRO environment , excellent analytical and presentation skills, and the ability to engage credibly with department heads and senior operational leaders.

Main Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own and deliver portfolio‑level financial analysis for Clinical Solutions departments, including budget health, forecast accuracy, margin performance, and risk identification.
  • Lead project financial oversight across the full project lifecycle, from award through closeout, ensuring adherence to financial best practices and internal controls.
  • Perform variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) to identify drivers of change, scope creep, and emerging risks.
  • Partner with project finance teams to ensure consistency and integrity of project‑level data feeding portfolio reporting.
  • Support and enhance departmental forecasting and planning processes using clear, supportable assumptions.
  • Monitor budget consumption, earned value indicators, and change order impacts across portfolios.
  • Provide forward‑looking insights to support proactive financial decision‑making by operational leadership.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes, controls, and reporting standards.
  • Develop and maintain trial operations KPIs and measures that link operational performance to financial outcomes (e.g., enrollment pace vs. burn, milestone progress vs. revenue, site activity vs. cost).
  • Leverage Excel and Power BI to create scalable dashboards and analyses that support portfolio governance and executive review.
  • Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for non‑finance stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted finance partner to Clinical Solutions department heads, supporting planning, performance reviews, and strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare and deliver high‑quality presentations and executive‑ready materials summarizing portfolio performance, risks, and recommendations.
  • Support ad‑hoc analyses and special projects requested by Finance leadership, Clinical Operations leadership, or executive management.
  • Collaborate closely with Project Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, and Finance teams to ensure alignment between operational execution and financial reporting.

Minimum Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (or its international equivalent) + 5 years of related experience.

Preferred Education & Experience (optional)

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field (or its international equivalent).
  • Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in project finance, FP&A, or operational finance, with a strong preference for CRO or clinical research industry experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or analysing clinical trial portfolios and complex project financials.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (financial modelling, scenario analysis, large data sets).
  • Working knowledge of Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools.
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leaders and department heads.
  • Solid understanding of clinical trial financial drivers, project lifecycles, and contract/budget mechanics.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

  • Strong financial and analytical acumen with the ability to connect operational activity to financial outcomes.
  • Executive presence and confidence interacting with senior operational leaders.
  • Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives and recommendations.
  • High attention to detail balanced with a portfolio‑level, strategic mindset.
  • Self‑motivated, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment.

Compensation

Reasonable estimate of the current range: $76,400 CAD - $114,600 CAD. This role is also eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, health insurance, retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, and paid time off for sick leave and vacation, among other benefits.

Descrição

Efetuar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva de CHILLER, verificando condições de Fluxoits de água gelada e condensada e termostatos eletrônicos e de anticongelamento, revisando pressostatos de alta e baixa, medindo pressões e amperagens, limpando serpentinas, varetando condensadores, inspecionando torres de refrigeração e bombas de água gelada e condensada, regulando temperaturas, monitorando ruídos e outras anormalidades, trocando óleo de compressores e filtro secador do sistema, reapertando parafusos, substituindo terminais e cabos oxidados, trocando fusíveis, compressores, motores de ventiladores, bem como, revisando a parte elétrica, visando a produção de água gelada destinada ao Fancoil; Efetuar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva de FANCOIL, inspecionando quadros elétricos, lubrificando peças, trocando filtros, correias, rolamentos, bandejas, fios frouxos, terminais oxidados, hélices de ventiladores, turbinas e rolamentos de motores, desobstruindo drenos e filtros, realizando medições de temperatura de entrada e saída de água através de termômetro, pressões de alta e baixa de compressores através de manômetro e amperagem de motores através de multiteste, limpando serpentinas e bandejas, verificando atuadores, válvulas e termostatos, bem como, isolando tubulações de água gelada via colocação de isopor em dutos, visando a plena refrigeração de ambientes pertencentes ao Contrato; Efetuar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva de SELF-CONTAINED, limpando bandejas e casas de máquinas, verificando comandos elétricos, pressões de alta e baixa dos ciclos da máquina, condições de correias e outros componentes, trocando compressores, motores, correias, condensadores, evaporadores, válvulas de expansão, filtros secadores, rolamentos, mancais, eixos, contactores, relés e fusíveis, lavando condensadores, evaporadores e serpentinas, regulando a temperatura ambiente, inspecionando ruídos e outras anormalidades, controlando nível de água em torres de refrigeração, funcionamento de bombas centrífugas e vazão em tubulações de água de condensação, medindo a amperagem de compressores, reapertando ou substituindo chaves contactoras, reparando vazamentos e controlando a vazão de ar dentro de ambientes, a fim de possibilitar a plena refrigeração de instalações do Contrato.

Realizar limpeza completa de unidades internas e externas (filtros, serpentinas, bandejas e turbinas). Verificar e higienizar o sistema de drenagem para evitar entupimentos e vazamentos. Inspecionar estado das serpentinas e realizar desoxidação quando necessário. Medir e registrar temperaturas de operação, pressões de gás, corrente elétrica e tensão. Checar fixação, vibrações e ruídos incomuns nos equipamentos. Avaliar o desempenho térmico do equipamento para identificar perda de eficiência. Verificar integridade da tubulação frigorífera e do isolamento térmico. Examinar estado das pás dos ventiladores e sensores. Testar o controle remoto, funções e modos de operação.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Prospectar novos clientes e vender o portfólio ativo da OLX;

  • Residir em Bauru ou região;

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Publicidade, Marketing, Comunicação Social ou cursos relacionados;

Informações adicionais

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Technical Product Owner

As a Technical Product Owner at Swapcard, you will lead a squad of engineers, owning your product area end to end, from roadmap strategy to shipped features. You will talk to clients and end‑users, to internal sales and success teams, dig into usage data, and translate what you learn into a clear, prioritized backlog. You will write user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can actually build from. You will make the hard calls on what to build next, balancing new capabilities, technical debt, and bug fixes based on real customer impact. You will also be deeply involved in the technical side, understanding system constraints, discussing architecture trade‑offs with your developers, and working with designers to make sure what’s feasible is also what’s right for users. This is a role for someone who wants to own outcomes, not just manage a backlog.

What you will bring

  • 4+ years of product ownership (or a similar product role) in a software development environment. You’ve shipped features, managed trade‑offs, and worked closely with engineering teams.
  • A technical foundation. Whether through a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field—or through hands‑on experience—you understand how software systems work and can hold your own in technical discussions.
  • Strong analytical skills. You make decisions with data: feature feasibility, prioritization, success measurement. You validate assumptions before committing your team’s time.
  • Excellent prioritization instincts. You know how to sequence work across new features, technical debt, and bugs in a way that maximizes customer value.

How will you work

  • You are curious and proactive, you dig into technical systems, ask why often, and don’t wait to be told what to explore.
  • You collaborate naturally with engineers on architecture, designers on feasibility, and stakeholders on strategy. No silos.
  • You lead with empathy. You care about the people on your team as much as the product you’re building together.
  • You communicate clearly in English, our working language.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building AI‑powered features, payment systems, analytics dashboards, or website/page builders.
  • Familiarity with the events industry or marketplace platforms.

Benefits & Reasons To Join Swapcard

  • International team with 40+ nationalities.
  • Remote‑first policy with headquarters in Paris.
  • Thriving startup with career growth opportunities.
  • Open‑mind culture that appreciates differences.
  • Feedback‑driven, supportive & curious team with a DIY mindset.
  • Generous paid time off to ensure you have time for what matters most.
  • Remote perks designed to optimize your working experience.
  • In‑person social gatherings to celebrate our achievements.
  • 100 % of your health insurance contribution paid by Swapcard.
  • Work‑from‑home budget for equipment.
  • Co‑working space budget to support remote work in professional environments.
  • Learning budget to help you develop new and existing skills.
  • Mental health care initiatives to support your well‑being.

Equal Opportunity

Swapcard is committed to upholding equal employment practices and making merit‑based employment decisions. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences to apply, regardless of race, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy status, age, marital status, and status as a veteran. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Security Operations Analyst
description:
Security Operations Analyst (AI Training)

About The Role

We're partnering with leading AI research labs to build the next generation of intelligent security systems — and we need experienced SOC analysts to make it happen. Your hands‑on knowledge of threat detection, alert triage, and incident response will directly shape how AI reasons through real‑world security scenarios.

This is a unique opportunity to move beyond the day‑to‑day grind of the SOC and contribute to something bigger: teaching AI to think like a seasoned security analyst.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Analyze realistic SOC scenarios — alerts, incidents, and investigations — and document how you'd respond
  • Classify threat severity, identify root causes, and recommend appropriate response actions
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated security analysis for accuracy and real‑world alignment
  • Validate detection logic and investigation workflows against industry best practices
  • Provide structured feedback that helps AI systems reason the way experienced analysts actually do

Who You Are

  • 2+ years of hands‑on experience in a SOC, incident response, or security operations role
  • Solid familiarity with SIEM platforms, alert triage processes, and investigation workflows
  • Skilled at separating true positives from noise — you know what a real threat looks like
  • Clear and precise written communicator who can explain your reasoning
  • Self‑motivated and comfortable working independently on async, task‑based assignments

Nice to Have

  • Experience with threat hunting or red/blue team operations
  • Familiarity with frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK or NIST
  • Background in detection engineering or security tool configuration
  • Prior experience evaluating or working with AI systems

Why Join Us

  • Work on frontier AI projects alongside world‑class research teams
  • Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
  • Freelance autonomy with meaningful, intellectually engaging work
  • Directly influence how AI systems handle real‑world cybersecurity challenges
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

description:
Cloud Security Analyst (AI Training)

About The Role

We’re partnering with leading AI research labs to build smarter, safer AI systems — and we need cloud security practitioners who know how cloud environments fail in the real world. This isn't a theoretical exercise. You'll be working with real cloud security scenarios across AWS, GCP, and Azure, helping to evaluate and improve AI reasoning around misconfigurations, IAM failures, blast radius, and incident response. Your expertise directly shapes how the next generation of AI understands cloud security.

Job Details

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week
  • Location: Fully Remote

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze cloud security scenarios across AWS, GCP, and Azure to identify real‑world risks and failure patterns
  • Review and assess IAM, networking, storage, and container security issues
  • Classify security gaps, misconfigurations, and cloud‑related failures based on real‑world impact
  • Validate and improve AI‑generated security reasoning so it accurately reflects how cloud incidents actually unfold
  • Provide structured, expert feedback that helps frontier AI models reason more accurately about cloud threats

Who You Are

  • At least 2 years of hands‑on experience working with cloud environments in production
  • Solid understanding of cloud IAM, networking, storage, and container security
  • Familiar with real‑world misconfigurations and how cloud security incidents develop
  • Able to reason clearly about blast radius, risk exposure, and business impact
  • Clear and structured communicator — you can explain complex security concepts in writing

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud security tools (e.g., AWS Security Hub, GCP Security Command Center, Azure Defender)
  • Background in penetration testing, red teaming, or cloud incident response
  • Familiarity with frameworks like CIS Benchmarks, MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud, or CSA CCM
  • Certifications such as AWS Security Specialty, CCSP, or equivalent

Why Join Us

  • Work directly on frontier AI systems with top research labs
  • Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
  • Your real‑world expertise shapes how AI understands and reasons about cloud security
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)
description:
Company Description Dingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities. Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey. Role Description As a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime. In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results. With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence. Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality. Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life. Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics. Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities. Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality. Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records. Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes. Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences. Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management. Qualifications Experience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable. Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes. Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies. Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions. Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders. Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

description: JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.- Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.Requirements- A Bachelor’s degree- 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments- Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)- Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery- Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms- Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills- Ability to work independently in a fast paced environmentWhy JoVE?- A competitive compensation package.- You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.- Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.- Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Técnico De Serviços Em Maritimo

Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito. A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado. Tipos de equipamentos atendidos: - Radares - ECDIS - Satcoms - Rádios HF e VHF - GPS - Girobússola - Pilotos automáticos - Sirenes Qualificações do Técnico em Marítima: - Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.

- Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.
